kept: The paper's full mechanism chain: 8 EWM-aggregated first-level style factors (trailing 12-month min-max + entropy weights) -> LASSO screening of the second-level indicators -> Ridge / MLP / Random Forest each retrained monthly on a rolling 12-month panel with 1-month out-of-sample test (Algorithm 1) -> dynamic combination by IC_Mean, w_i = max(mu_IC_i, 0) / sum(max(mu_IC, 0)) over the trailing L=20 monthly Spearman ICs (Algorithm 2), combined predicted return = the cross-sectional score.
changed: (A) UNIVERSE/SAMPLE. A1 CSI 300 -> K200 union KQ150, PIT time-varying membership read from the signal-date RAWDATA row. A2 sample 2018-01~2022-12 (paper backtest 2020-01~2022-12) -> feature/burn-in panel attempted from 1996-01 over whatever months the KR monthly Factor DB actually covers, graded period per harness axis 2005-01~; scores can only begin after 12-month EWM window + 12-month training window + L=20 IC burn-in, i.e. about 44 months after the first available Factor DB month. A3 liquidity floor adv20 >= 2e8 KRW applied at t-1 (harness axis, not in the paper), computed as shift(frollmean(Close*Vol, 20), 1) by ticker and requiring 20 consecutive non-missing daily trade-value observations; that 20-observation requirement is also how the paper's 'newly listed within the past month' exclusion is implemented. A4 the paper's ST / suspended exclusions are mapped to the RAWDATA flags AdminStock / TradingHalt / UnfaithfulDisc read at the signal date; values that are not affirmatively true (NA, unparsable, absent column) are treated as NOT flagged (lenient, because these flags are absent in early vintages and excluding on NA would delete whole early periods). (B) FEATURES. B1 the paper's 50 CNE5-style second-level indicators built from Chinese market fields are replaced by 45 KR Factor DB indicators mapped onto the paper's own 8 first-level groups; see mapping below. Not available and NOT reconstructed or proxied: the order-size money-flow reversal factors (dSm/dMd/dLg/dElg), the industry-excess information-ratio variants (dIR_industry_*), total market value cubed, quarterly turnover. B2 indicator values are Z_Score_Aligned from load_month_factors() (cross-sectional z-score, direction-aligned by the connector's expanding Usable_Date<=sig_date IC path) instead of the paper's raw indicator values -- mandated by PIT C13/C15; the min-max step is applied to these aligned z-scores. B3 per-group indicator counts: size 3 (paper 4), reverse 12, volatility 4, earnings 4, growth 7, valuation 5, leverage 6, liquidity 4 = 45 total vs the paper's 50. B4 indicators whose monthly coverage falls below the connector default coverage_min=0.05 are dropped by the connector for that month and the group aggregates its remaining indicators. B5 a first-level factor whose mapped indicators are ALL absent from the monthly Factor DB cannot be built, so the model's feature set is narrowed to the first-level factors that actually materialised (minimum 2, else the engine stops) and the dropped group names are logged; this is a data-availability narrowing, not a performance-based selection, and it means the model may run on fewer than the paper's 8 first-level inputs. (C) EWM APPROXIMATION. C1 the entropy is computed in decomposable closed form from the per-month min-max-scaled values pooled over the trailing 12 month-slots (each month scaled by its own trailing window), NOT by re-scaling the whole 12-month window with the decision month's min/max as the paper's step-1-then-step-3 ordering implies; identity used: sum(p*ln p) = (S2 - S1*ln S1)/S1 with S1, S2, N trailing sums of per-month partials. This is an approximation of the paper's formula, adopted because the literal form has no closed decomposition and would require a 12x panel expansion. C2 0*ln0 := 0. C3 degenerate min-max range (hi-lo <= 1e-12) -> scaled value 0.5; scaled values clipped to [0,1]. C4 entropy weight w = max(1-e, 0), normalised within the group over the indicators actually observed for that stock-month (missing indicators are excluded and the weights renormalised); if every observed indicator in a group has weight 0 the group score falls back to the simple mean of its scaled values. C5 the trailing min-max / entropy window uses the months available inside the trailing 12 slots and is undefined for the first 11 slots. (D) SCREENING. D1 LASSO is refit MONTHLY on the same rolling 12-month training panel (the paper's only stated window), instead of the single 50->37 screening the paper reports without stating any window or refit cadence; a one-off full-sample screening would violate PIT C1. D2 lambda chosen by 5-fold cv.glmnet lambda.min (the paper states no lambda and no CV scheme); fold assignment seeded. D3 LASSO design matrix only: missing indicator values are imputed with 0.5, the midpoint of the paper's min-max [0,1] range; zero-variance columns are dropped; indicators with no observation anywhere in the window have no column and therefore cannot survive. The EWM aggregation does NOT use this imputation. D4 screening may not delete a whole first-level factor: a group left with zero survivors falls back to all of its available indicators, because the paper's model always has 8 first-level inputs. If cv.glmnet errors, all indicators are retained for that month. (E) MODELS. E1 hyperparameters, none of which the paper states: Ridge = glmnet alpha=0 with lambda by 5-fold CV lambda.min; MLP = nnet single hidden layer of 8 units, decay 1e-3, maxit 300, linout=TRUE, MaxNWts 4000 (the paper says only 'multiple layers of interconnected neurons' and gives no depth or width); RF = ranger 500 trees, mtry = floor(sqrt(8)) = 2, min.node.size 5, num.threads 1. E2 the MLP target is standardised with training-window mean/sd and the predictions are mapped back to return units, so that the three models combine on one scale; needed because monthly returns are ~1e-2 while the weight decay is 1e-3, which would otherwise shrink the MLP output layer to zero. Paper silent. E3 set.seed(20250826 + month index) before each CV / MLP / RF fit and the same value passed as ranger's seed; the paper is silent on seeds, restarts and ensembling, and there is exactly one fit per model per month (no restarts, no outer ensemble). E4 regression task only; the paper also trains a classification task (rise/fall) whose precision/recall/F1 feed its static weighting -- that branch is not implemented. E5 labels are NOT winsorized (paper silent); RAWDATA Ret is already sanitized upstream. The monthly label is the compounded return over (month_end[mi], month_end[mi+1]] using whatever trading days the stock actually had, so a mid-period delisting shortens the window; no minimum day count is imposed. (F) COMBINATION. F1 CELL CHOSEN: IC_Mean dynamic weighting WITH factor screening -- the paper's own best cell (results (2) and (3), Tables 4 and 6). The static evaluation-metric weightings (1/RMSE, 1/MAPE, Precision, Recall, F1-score) and the IC_Ratio weighting are NOT implemented. F2 L=20 is read as 20 MONTHS: the data are monthly and the paper's static-weighting text says 'rolling average ... over the past 20 trading months', while its dIR factor definitions use a 20-trading-day window; Algorithm 2 never resolves the unit. F3 mu_IC is averaged over the IC observations actually present in the trailing 20-month window and requires at least 10 of 20 per model, whereas the paper assumes all L exist; an IC observation is produced only when at least 20 stocks have both a prediction and a realised label. F4 when sum(max(mu_IC,0)) = 0 (Algorithm 2 line 14 sets all weights to 0) no scores are emitted for that month, and the simulator consequently carries the previous holdings forward to the next scored month. F5 months with a failed fit, fewer than 100 training rows, or fewer than 20 scorable stocks emit no scores. (G) PORTFOLIO LAYER. G1 the paper never states a holding count, a position-weighting scheme, or long-only vs long-short -- Algorithm 1 line 7 says only 'Form portfolio based on predicted returns'. The engine therefore emits FACTORS(Date, Ticker, Score) and the portfolio layer uses the harness fixed axis: top 25 by Score, equal-weight. The monthly rebalance IS the paper's ('the training and test windows are advanced by one month'). G2 a stock-month enters the model panel only if every available first-level factor score is finite (complete cases, see B5); paper silent. (H) COST CONVENTION. H1 the paper states a 'total cost rate set at 0.3%' without splitting buy and sell, read here as round-trip and recorded as commission_paper = 0.003. The harness charges sum(|dw|) * commission per rebalance, so passing 0.003 charges 0.3% per side (0.6% round-trip on a full turnover); the one-way equivalent of the paper's 0.3% round-trip is 0.0015. Flagged, not silently converted. The grade is produced at the harness's own 15bps regardless. (I) MAPPING TABLE, paper first-level group -> KR Factor DB second-level indicators. size: S01_Size, S02_Float_Size, L26_Log_MktCap. reverse: M04_Mom_1, M03_Mom_3_1, M02_Mom_6_1, M11_ST_Reversal, M22_Max_Return, M29_Mom_5d, L43_Turnover_Change, L03_Volume_Mom, L34_Vol_Spike_Ratio, L35_Reversal_Intensity, CR09_Money_Flow_Ratio, D53_Range_Vol. volatility: D02_Beta, D01_IdioVol, D03_RealVol, D42_EWMA_Vol. earnings: V02_EP, V03_CFP, V10_FCF_Yield, V11_Shareholder_Yield. growth: GR01_Revenue_Growth, GR02_Earnings_Growth, GR04_GPA_Growth, GR05_ROE_Growth, GR06_OCF_Growth, Q07_Earnings_Stability, Q33_Earnings_Persistence. valuation: V01_BM, V07_EV_EBITDA, V08_PSR, V13_EV_Sales, V16_Tobins_Q. leverage: R17_Market_Leverage, R18_Book_Leverage, Q16_Debt_to_Assets, Q15_Debt_to_Equity, Q13_Fin_Leverage, D60_Leverage. liquidity: L02_Turnover, L15_Turnover_252d, L01_Amihud, L05_Dollar_Volume. The paper's Earnings group (yield-to-price) and Valuation group (price multiples) are near-inverses of each other in the paper itself; that redundancy is mirrored rather than removed, since the paper's own LASSO screening is its stated remedy. R17/R18/Q16 are the literal CNE5 Mlev/Blev/Dtoa analogues and Q07_Earnings_Stability is the analogue of the paper's dIR_eps earnings-stability information ratio. (J) PIT NOTE. A monthly Factor DB panel is consumed only if its reported as-of month equals the requested month and its as-of date is <= the requested date; the connector otherwise substitutes the closest earlier month file, and that substitution is rejected instead of being consumed as a stale panel. Training labels and IC observations each carry an explicit realisation date and the engine hard-asserts that none of them postdates the decision date.
paper_original_form: A cross-sectional next-month expected-return forecast per stock: a combined (IC_Mean-weighted) prediction from Ridge / MLP / Random Forest trained monthly on a rolling 12-month panel of 8 EWM-aggregated CNE5-style factors over CSI 300 constituents, with the portfolio-formation step left unspecified ('Form portfolio based on predicted returns') and a 0.3% total cost rate.

source_paper.title: Combined machine learning for stock selection strategy based on dynamic weighting methods
source_paper.authors: Lin Cai, Zhiyang He, Caiya Zhang

changed_items: A1 universe CSI 300 -> K200 union KQ150 (PIT time-varying membership)
A2 sample window: burn-in panel from 1996-01 over available Factor DB months; scoring starts ~44 months after the first available month (12m EWM + 12m train + 20m IC)
A3 adv20 >= 2e8 KRW liquidity floor at t-1, 20 consecutive non-missing observations required (harness axis; also implements the paper's newly-listed exclusion)
A4 paper's ST/suspended exclusions mapped to AdminStock / TradingHalt / UnfaithfulDisc at the signal date; non-affirmative values treated as not flagged
B1 paper's 50 CNE5 second-level indicators replaced by 45 KR Factor DB indicators; order-size money flows, industry-excess IR variants, size-cubed and quarterly turnover not available and not proxied
B2 indicator values = Z_Score_Aligned (C13/C15 mandated) instead of the paper's raw values
B3 per-group indicator counts differ (45 vs 50; size 3 vs paper's 4)
B4 connector coverage_min = 0.05 drops thin indicators per month
B5 first-level factors with no materialised indicator in the monthly Factor DB are dropped from the feature set (logged, minimum 2 required) -- the model may run on fewer than the paper's 8 inputs
C1 entropy computed in decomposable closed form from per-month-scaled values pooled over the trailing 12 slots (approximation of the paper's scale-then-pool ordering)
C3 degenerate min-max range -> 0.5; scaled values clipped to [0,1]
C4 entropy weights renormalised over observed indicators only; all-zero-weight group falls back to the simple mean
C5 trailing window undefined for the first 11 month-slots; uses available months inside the window
D1 LASSO refit monthly on the 12-month training window instead of the paper's single unspecified-window screening (full-sample screening would violate C1)
D2 LASSO lambda = 5-fold cv.glmnet lambda.min (paper states none), seeded
D3 LASSO design matrix missing values imputed with 0.5; zero-variance columns dropped; unobserved indicators have no column
D4 screening cannot delete a whole first-level factor (zero-survivor group falls back to all its indicators); cv.glmnet error -> retain all
E1 all model hyperparameters invented (paper gives none): ridge lambda by 5-fold CV; nnet size 8 / decay 1e-3 / maxit 300 / linout; ranger 500 trees / mtry 2 / min.node.size 5 / 1 thread
E2 MLP target standardised on the training window and predictions mapped back to return units (scale conditioning; needed for the linear combination to be meaningful)
E3 set.seed(20250826 + month index) before each fit, same value as ranger seed; one fit per model per month, no restarts, no outer ensemble
E4 regression task only; the paper's classification branch (feeding its static precision/recall/F1 weighting) not implemented
E5 labels not winsorized; monthly label uses whatever trading days the stock had, no minimum day count
F1 cell chosen = IC_Mean weighting WITH factor screening (paper Tables 4/6 best cell); static metric weightings and IC_Ratio not implemented
F2 L=20 read as 20 months (paper never resolves the unit for Algorithm 2)
F3 mu_IC averaged over available IC observations in the window, minimum 10 of 20 per model; IC requires >= 20 paired stocks
F4 sum(max(mu_IC,0)) = 0 -> no scores that month (previous holdings carry forward)
F5 failed fit / <100 training rows / <20 scorable stocks -> no scores that month
G1 portfolio layer (holding count, position weights, long-only) not stated by the paper -> harness fixed axis top-25 equal-weight; monthly rebalance is the paper's
G2 stock-month requires every available first-level factor score to be finite (complete cases)
H1 paper's 0.3% 'total cost rate' read as round-trip; the harness charges it per side, so 0.003 = 0.6% round-trip while 0.0015 is the one-way equivalent -- flagged, not silently converted
J1 stale/substituted Factor DB panels rejected (as-of month must equal the requested month) instead of being consumed
